parentID.description: Set parentID to create a subagent session at the parent's location; set agent to choose its agent (otherwise it uses the default) and start it with session.prompt. After each completed round, the child sends a `<subagent>` report to the parent's inbox and wakes the parent unless it has a staged revert.

archived.description: Archive the session with true or restore it with false. Repeating the current state is a no-op.

schema.description: Only send events of these types, plus the initial server.connected event. When omitted, all events are sent.

Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

data.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions and executing multi-step tasks. Use this agent to execute multiple units of work in parallel.

data.name: Explore
data.description: Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Use this when you need to quickly find files by patterns (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), search code for keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer questions about the codebase (eg. "how do API endpoints work?"). When calling this agent, specify the desired thoroughness level: "quick" for basic searches, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" for comprehensive analysis across multiple locations and naming conventions.

data.name: Plan
data.description: Read-only agent for exploring the codebase and planning work before implementation.
